HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #11
====

GRADE: Grade 1
SUBJECT: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Ramayan and Sri Guru Granth Sahib ji? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Ramayan and Sri Guru Granth Sahib ji with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Ramayan and Sri Guru Granth Sahib ji.
   C. Say Ramayan and Sri Guru Granth Sahib ji has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Ramayan and Sri Guru Granth Sahib ji to insult classmates of other faiths.

2. Which response best shows understanding of Myself [? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Myself [ with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Myself [ has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Myself [.
   D. Use Myself [ to insult classmates of other faiths.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Religious? (1 mark)
   A. Say Religious has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Religious with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Religious to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Religious.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Qualities Of Enlightened Beings? (1 mark)
   A. Say Qualities Of Enlightened Beings has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Qualities Of Enlightened Beings with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Qualities Of Enlightened Beings.
   D. Use Qualities Of Enlightened Beings to insult classmates of other faiths.

5. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Skipping all moral lessons
   B. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   C. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   D. Refusing to help a neighbour

6. Which response best shows understanding of Basic Prayers? (1 mark)
   A. Say Basic Prayers has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Basic Prayers to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Basic Prayers with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Basic Prayers.

7. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Waste food daily
   B. Destroy trees without planting
   C. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   D. Pollute rivers deliberately

8. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   B. Spreading rumours
   C. Cheating in exams
   D. Hiding stolen items

9. Which response best shows understanding of General Etiquette:? (1 mark)
   A. Say General Etiquette: has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing General Etiquette:.
   C. Use General Etiquette: to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of General Etiquette: with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

10. Which response best shows understanding of Pranayam? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Pranayam with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Pranayam has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Pranayam.
   D. Use Pranayam to insult classmates of other faiths.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
11. In three clear sentences, explain Qualities Of Enlightened Beings and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

12. In three clear sentences, explain Ramayan and Sri Guru Granth Sahib ji and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

13. In three clear sentences, explain Pranayam and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain General Etiquette: and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
